notes:
July 13th 2026
Version 12.1+ (stable) / 12.2+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Receive User Programs from your accordion — the reverse of "Send to Accordion." Right-click a User Program or a whole bank in the tree and choose "Receive … from Accordion (Via USB)" to pull it straight off the instrument into your open list, with no USB stick needed. It loads into the file (nothing is saved until you Save, and you can Undo). (R)
* Export the current program or bank to a .UPG / .UPB file right from the Live UPG Editor — the Export options are now always available on the left-hand side. (R)
* Smoother Set / User-Program mode switching in the Live Editor — a "Please wait" message now covers the few seconds it takes to reload (no more blank screen), the mode Switch button stays put instead of jumping, and Set mode now shows the Set's name next to the button, just like User-Program mode. (R)
* The Export (CSV/PDF) button in the tree's Print preview now sits next to Print, so it is no longer cut off on smaller screens. (R)
* Colorblind-friendly "Highlight Differences" — when comparing two backups, the results now use distinct shapes (circle, square, triangle) as well as colors, so matching, renamed, and different items are easy to tell apart at a glance. (K,R)
notes_beta:
July 14th 2026
Version 12.3+ (stable) / 12.4+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Now available in 8 languages — English, Deutsch, Nederlands, Français, Svenska, Italiano, Português and Русский. (K,R)
* A new illustrated user manual in the Help menu — web page or PDF, in every language. (R)
* Send a User Program or a whole bank from the tree to your accordion over the USB cable — no memory stick needed. (R)
* Receive a User Program or a whole bank from your accordion the same way, straight into the tree. (R)
* Save any program or bank to a .UPG or .UPB file right from the Live Editor. (R)
* Open a Set file (.FR4 / .FR8) in the tree to rename, export, or edit its sets. (R)
* Live Set Editor (beta) — read, edit, and write Sets live on your USB-connected accordion. (R)
* One clear "Print / Export" button (PDF, CSV, HTML, text) that's always easy to find. (R)
* Compare two backups by shape and color — easy to read even if you're colorblind, now including .UPB files. (K,R)
* Set how long tips stay on screen, in Preferences. (K,R)
* Fixed a false "settings don't match your accordion" message on the first send with some FR-4X setups. (R)
* Organ reverb, chorus, and delay now edit and save correctly. (R)
* Drum bellows and free-bass edits are now heard right away, not only after reloading. (R)
* Expansion-pack voices now show the right name instead of "[Not Installed]". (R)
* Fixed treble reed and Cassotto settings that could be lost when saving. (R)
* Corrected a couple dozen Korg scene settings that could show or save wrong. (K)
* Fixed garbled text in printed and PDF lists. (K,R)
* Plus many smaller accuracy and reliability fixes. (K,R)
